title: mineflayer-pathfinder issue #227 — stuck on 2 block gap (physics mismatch)
content_excerpt: Issue #227 (opened 2021-12-14, still open, opened by a repository collaborator): "the physics simulations fail to make the jump over the 2 block gap without sprinting even tho the getMoveParkourForward provides a move for a 2 block jump. The jump should be possible in vanilla so this might be a problem with simulated physics." Reported against 1.12.2 with the then-current pathfinder build; no fix recorded.
evidence_notes: 野外证据：'寻路认为可达'与'物理执行做不到'可以同时成立，表现为反复尝试同一跳跃并卡住。作者为协作者，可信度高于普通报告，但问题仍未修复，因此仍标 B。
notes: 摘录已剔除作者信息；版本较旧，不能直接外推到 26.3。
